decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Yield to a pedestrian in a crosswalk, ____.
cards.back: Yield to a pedestrian in a crosswalk, stopping when required.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not overtake a vehicle that has stopped to ____.
cards.back: Do not overtake a vehicle that has stopped to let a pedestrian cross.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Watch especially carefully for children near schools and homes, and do ____.
cards.back: Watch especially carefully for children near schools and homes, and do not speed in school zones.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Check traffic carefully before getting out ____.
cards.back: Check traffic carefully before getting out of a vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pedestrians must use an available sidewalk; without one, walk on the shoulder facing traffic and as ____.
cards.back: Pedestrians must use an available sidewalk; without one, walk on the shoulder facing traffic and as far from the roadway as possible.
cards.memory_hook: far from the roadway as possible

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A pedestrian walking along a road at night must carry ____.
cards.back: A pedestrian walking along a road at night must carry a light or reflector.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Light-colored clothing is recommended for pedestrians ____.
cards.back: Light-colored clothing is recommended for pedestrians when possible.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Walking on a highway under the influence of alcohol or ____.
cards.back: Walking on a highway under the influence of alcohol or narcotic drugs is prohibited.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not stand on a highway to solicit a ____.
cards.back: Do not stand on a highway to solicit a ride or conduct business.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pedestrians should cross at marked crosswalks; when none exists, cross at an intersection; without an intersection, look both ____.
cards.back: Pedestrians should cross at marked crosswalks; when none exists, cross at an intersection; without an intersection, look both ways and cross quickly when needed.
cards.memory_hook: ways and cross quickly when needed

decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pedestrians must follow WALK and DON’T WALK signals; blinking DON’T ____.
cards.back: Pedestrians must follow WALK and DON’T WALK signals; blinking DON’T WALK prohibits beginning the crossing.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before crossing at an intersection, pedestrians must watch ____.
cards.back: Before crossing at an intersection, pedestrians must watch for turning cars.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Diagonal intersection crossings are prohibited unless traffic-control ____.
cards.back: Diagonal intersection crossings are prohibited unless traffic-control signals authorize them.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pedestrians have priority at an intersection when their green light ____.
cards.back: Pedestrians have priority at an intersection when their green light or WALK signal permits crossing.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pedestrians have priority while crossing in either a ____.
cards.back: Pedestrians have priority while crossing in either a marked or unmarked crosswalk.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pedestrians on a sidewalk have priority as it crosses an ____.
cards.back: Pedestrians on a sidewalk have priority as it crosses an alley, driveway or entrance.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Blind pedestrians crossing with a white cane or ____.
cards.back: Blind pedestrians crossing with a white cane or guide dog have priority.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pedestrians must yield when crossing outside a marked crosswalk or ____.
cards.back: Pedestrians must yield when crossing outside a marked crosswalk or an unmarked intersection crosswalk.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Pedestrians must yield when crossing a roadway where an overhead crossing ____.
cards.back: Pedestrians must yield when crossing a roadway where an overhead crossing or pedestrian tunnel is provided.

decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Cyclists may use Delaware public roads ____.
cards.back: Cyclists may use Delaware public roads except limited-access highways.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When a lane is too narrow for safe side-by-side travel, a motorist passing a bicycle must change lanes, including across a double yellow line, ____.
cards.back: When a lane is too narrow for safe side-by-side travel, a motorist passing a bicycle must change lanes, including across a double yellow line, and leave at least three feet.
cards.memory_hook: and leave at least three feet

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A motorist must not sound the horn at a cyclist ____.
cards.back: A motorist must not sound the horn at a cyclist unless danger is imminent.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist should keep right as far ____.
cards.back: A cyclist should keep right as far as safety permits.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bike box is a designated space at the front of an intersection traffic lane that ____.
cards.back: A bike box is a designated space at the front of an intersection traffic lane that makes cyclists visible and assists turning.
cards.memory_hook: makes cyclists visible and assists turning

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bike box helps prevent conflicts with right-turning vehicles and limits ____.
cards.back: A bike box helps prevent conflicts with right-turning vehicles and limits vehicle encroachment on the crosswalk.

decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A two-way cycle track separates cycling from motor traffic and carries bicycles both ways ____.
cards.back: A two-way cycle track separates cycling from motor traffic and carries bicycles both ways along one side of the road.
cards.memory_hook: along one side of the road

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A street-level protected cycle track can use a parking lane or another barrier ____.
cards.back: A street-level protected cycle track can use a parking lane or another barrier to separate it from motor traffic.
cards.memory_hook: to separate it from motor traffic

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Passing too close at higher speeds can create air pressure capable of making a cyclist crash, ____.
cards.back: Passing too close at higher speeds can create air pressure capable of making a cyclist crash, especially beside a truck or bus.
cards.memory_hook: especially beside a truck or bus

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If a lane cannot safely fit a vehicle and bicycle together, the passing driver must move fully into another ____.
cards.back: If a lane cannot safely fit a vehicle and bicycle together, the passing driver must move fully into another lane, even across double yellow lines.
cards.memory_hook: lane, even across double yellow lines

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: In an unusually wide lane that safely fits both, a driver may pass a bicycle within the lane only while slowing and maintaining ____.
cards.back: In an unusually wide lane that safely fits both, a driver may pass a bicycle within the lane only while slowing and maintaining at least three feet of clearance.
cards.memory_hook: at least three feet of clearance

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: On a two-lane road, if sight distance or opposing traffic prevents safe bicycle passing, follow at a ____.
cards.back: On a two-lane road, if sight distance or opposing traffic prevents safe bicycle passing, follow at a safe gap until passing becomes safe.
cards.memory_hook: safe gap until passing becomes safe

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After passing a cyclist, allow ample clearance before moving back right because the ____.
cards.back: After passing a cyclist, allow ample clearance before moving back right because the bicycle may be faster than expected.
cards.memory_hook: bicycle may be faster than expected

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The detailed bicycle-passing rule allows horn use only to warn ____.
cards.back: The detailed bicycle-passing rule allows horn use only to warn of an imminent collision.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Check carefully for cyclists before entering a road or turning, and do not pass a cyclist only to ____.
cards.back: Check carefully for cyclists before entering a road or turning, and do not pass a cyclist only to turn immediately across the bicycle’s path.
cards.memory_hook: turn immediately across the bicycle’s path

decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Parents or guardians can be responsible for a child’s cycling traffic-law violations and for an ____.
cards.back: Parents or guardians can be responsible for a child’s cycling traffic-law violations and for an under-eighteen child riding without a helmet.
cards.memory_hook: under-eighteen child riding without a helmet

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before riding in traffic, a cyclist should master straight riding, ____.
cards.back: Before riding in traffic, a cyclist should master straight riding, turns and smooth stops.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Cyclists should be prepared to yield to motor vehicles at intersections even ____.
cards.back: Cyclists should be prepared to yield to motor vehicles at intersections even when they believe they have priority.
cards.memory_hook: when they believe they have priority

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At night, a bicycle requires a white headlamp and red rear reflector; extra reflectors ____.
cards.back: At night, a bicycle requires a white headlamp and red rear reflector; extra reflectors and a red taillamp are helpful.
cards.memory_hook: and a red taillamp are helpful

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Predictable cycling means traveling with traffic, signaling intentions early and choosing a path ____.
cards.back: Predictable cycling means traveling with traffic, signaling intentions early and choosing a path that avoids sudden swerves into traffic.
cards.memory_hook: that avoids sudden swerves into traffic

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: In an unusually wide lane, a cyclist should ride on its right side to permit safe in-lane passing when ____.
cards.back: In an unusually wide lane, a cyclist should ride on its right side to permit safe in-lane passing when the cyclist feels safe doing so.
cards.memory_hook: the cyclist feels safe doing so

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle used at night needs a white headlight visible ____.
cards.back: A bicycle used at night needs a white headlight visible at five hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle used at night needs a red rear reflector ____.
cards.back: A bicycle used at night needs a red rear reflector visible at six hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Nighttime bicycle side visibility requires either reflective material visible from both sides at six hundred feet or a lamp visible from ____.
cards.back: Nighttime bicycle side visibility requires either reflective material visible from both sides at six hundred feet or a lamp visible from both sides at five hundred feet.
cards.memory_hook: both sides at five hundred feet

decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle taillight ____.
cards.back: A bicycle taillight is recommended.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle rider must sit on or astride ____.
cards.back: A bicycle rider must sit on or astride a permanent seat.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle may carry a passenger only when ____.
cards.back: A bicycle may carry a passenger only when designed for one.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist must not cling to another vehicle ____.
cards.back: A cyclist must not cling to another vehicle on the highway.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist must not ride facing ____.
cards.back: A cyclist must not ride facing highway traffic.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bicycle rider must keep at least one ____.
cards.back: A bicycle rider must keep at least one hand on the handlebars.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Cyclists must yield to pedestrians on sidewalks and crosswalks and sound an ____.
cards.back: Cyclists must yield to pedestrians on sidewalks and crosswalks and sound an audible warning before passing them.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Cyclists must not use a headset that ____.
cards.back: Cyclists must not use a headset that covers both ears.

decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Every cyclist younger than eighteen must wear a correctly ____.
cards.back: Every cyclist younger than eighteen must wear a correctly fitted, fastened bicycle helmet.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist must stop at a stop sign where the intersecting major road ____.
cards.back: A cyclist must stop at a stop sign where the intersecting major road has at least three travel lanes.
cards.memory_hook: has at least three travel lanes

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A cyclist must stop if a motor vehicle is already stopped at ____.
cards.back: A cyclist must stop if a motor vehicle is already stopped at the stop sign the cyclist approaches.
cards.memory_hook: the stop sign the cyclist approaches

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Heavy traffic requiring a stop for safety also requires a cyclist ____.
cards.back: Heavy traffic requiring a stop for safety also requires a cyclist to stop at the sign.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: At a minor-road stop sign without a stopped vehicle ahead, a cyclist may slow, yield to vehicles at or approaching the ____.
cards.back: At a minor-road stop sign without a stopped vehicle ahead, a cyclist may slow, yield to vehicles at or approaching the intersection, and proceed cautiously without stopping.
cards.memory_hook: intersection, and proceed cautiously without stopping

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A shared-lane marking reminds motorists and cyclists that both may lawfully use the lane ____.
cards.back: A shared-lane marking reminds motorists and cyclists that both may lawfully use the lane and supports safe positioning and passing.
cards.memory_hook: and supports safe positioning and passing

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Check blind spots frequently for motorcycles, especially before intersection turns or entry ____.
cards.back: Check blind spots frequently for motorcycles, especially before intersection turns or entry from a side road or driveway.
cards.memory_hook: from a side road or driveway

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Motorcyclists have the same roadway rights and responsibilities ____.
cards.back: Motorcyclists have the same roadway rights and responsibilities as other highway users.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Motorcycles can be difficult to detect, and their distance and speed can ____.
cards.back: Motorcycles can be difficult to detect, and their distance and speed can be hard for drivers to judge.
cards.memory_hook: be hard for drivers to judge

decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before turning left across a motorcycle’s path, look again and establish ____.
cards.back: Before turning left across a motorcycle’s path, look again and establish the motorcycle’s position and speed.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not assume a motorcycle’s flashing turn signal guarantees a turn; the ____.
cards.back: Do not assume a motorcycle’s flashing turn signal guarantees a turn; the rider may have left it on.
cards.memory_hook: rider may have left it on

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When following a motorcycle below forty miles per hour, the ____.
cards.back: When following a motorcycle below forty miles per hour, the handbook specifies a two-second gap.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When following a motorcycle above forty miles per hour, the ____.
cards.back: When following a motorcycle above forty miles per hour, the handbook specifies a four-second gap.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Increase the motorcycle-following gap on a wet ____.
cards.back: Increase the motorcycle-following gap on a wet or slippery road.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A motorcycle is entitled to a full lane; never drive alongside it within that lane even ____.
cards.back: A motorcycle is entitled to a full lane; never drive alongside it within that lane even if there seems to be room.
cards.memory_hook: if there seems to be room

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Allow extra room behind motorcycles in poor weather and watch for wet-surface ____.
cards.back: Allow extra room behind motorcycles in poor weather and watch for wet-surface glare that can hide the rider.
cards.memory_hook: glare that can hide the rider

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Crosswinds and wind blasts from large trucks can cause sudden changes in ____.
cards.back: Crosswinds and wind blasts from large trucks can cause sudden changes in a motorcycle’s speed or direction.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Debris, gravel, pavement seams, animals or manhole covers can cause a motorcycle ____.
cards.back: Debris, gravel, pavement seams, animals or manhole covers can cause a motorcycle to change speed or course.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A motorcycle rider may slow or alter course to meet angled railway tracks head-on and may rise ____.
cards.back: A motorcycle rider may slow or alter course to meet angled railway tracks head-on and may rise from the seat over rough tracks.
cards.memory_hook: from the seat over rough tracks

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Metal or grated bridges can produce a motorcycle-tire wobble that prompts an inexperienced ____.
cards.back: Metal or grated bridges can produce a motorcycle-tire wobble that prompts an inexperienced rider to slow or change direction.
cards.memory_hook: rider to slow or change direction

decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Animal riders and animal-drawn-vehicle drivers share motorists’ highway rights and duties except laws ____.
cards.back: Animal riders and animal-drawn-vehicle drivers share motorists’ highway rights and duties except laws that cannot apply by their nature.
cards.memory_hook: that cannot apply by their nature

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Drivers of farm tractors and other self-propelled equipment have ordinary motorists’ highway rights and duties, with additional ____.
cards.back: Drivers of farm tractors and other self-propelled equipment have ordinary motorists’ highway rights and duties, with additional special requirements in a separate supplement.
cards.memory_hook: special requirements in a separate supplement

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Vehicles that the DMV cannot register, such as minibikes, go-carts, golf carts, dirtbikes, motorized scooters and specified all-terrain vehicles, ____.
cards.back: Vehicles that the DMV cannot register, such as minibikes, go-carts, golf carts, dirtbikes, motorized scooters and specified all-terrain vehicles, must not be driven on highways.
cards.memory_hook: must not be driven on highways

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The slow-moving-vehicle emblem is an orange fluorescent and reflective triangle; on seeing ____.
cards.back: The slow-moving-vehicle emblem is an orange fluorescent and reflective triangle; on seeing it, slow promptly and proceed carefully.
cards.memory_hook: it, slow promptly and proceed carefully

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Before passing a truck, check ahead and behind and enter the passing lane only where passing is ____.
cards.back: Before passing a truck, check ahead and behind and enter the passing lane only where passing is legal and the lane is clear.
cards.memory_hook: legal and the lane is clear

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If needed, blink the headlights to alert a truck driver ____.
cards.back: If needed, blink the headlights to alert a truck driver before passing, particularly at night.

decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Complete a pass promptly instead of remaining alongside ____.
cards.back: Complete a pass promptly instead of remaining alongside the other vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: After passing a truck, a blink of its headlights can indicate clearance, but return only after seeing the ____.
cards.back: After passing a truck, a blink of its headlights can indicate clearance, but return only after seeing the truck’s front in the rear-view mirror.
cards.memory_hook: truck’s front in the rear-view mirror

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Maintain your speed after finishing a pass ____.
cards.back: Maintain your speed after finishing a pass of a truck.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When a truck passes, keep to the far side of your lane, consider ____.
cards.back: When a truck passes, keep to the far side of your lane, consider slowing slightly and do not accelerate.
cards.memory_hook: slowing slightly and do not accelerate

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When meeting an opposing truck, stay as far to your side as possible ____.
cards.back: When meeting an opposing truck, stay as far to your side as possible to reduce sideswipe risk and turbulence.
cards.memory_hook: to reduce sideswipe risk and turbulence

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook says turbulence between meeting vehicles pushes them apart ____.
cards.back: The handbook says turbulence between meeting vehicles pushes them apart rather than drawing them together.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A truck’s No-Zone refers to danger areas and blind spots around it ____.
cards.back: A truck’s No-Zone refers to danger areas and blind spots around it where collisions are more likely.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Keep a consistent speed while passing a large vehicle and wait until its cab appears in your rear-view ____.
cards.back: Keep a consistent speed while passing a large vehicle and wait until its cab appears in your rear-view mirror before moving ahead of it.
cards.memory_hook: mirror before moving ahead of it

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Never pass closely behind a truck that is backing because both drivers can lose sight ____.
cards.back: Never pass closely behind a truck that is backing because both drivers can lose sight of one another in that area.
cards.memory_hook: of one another in that area

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A truck has a deep blind spot behind it; maintain at least ____.
cards.back: A truck has a deep blind spot behind it; maintain at least four seconds of following space.

decks.module: Truck blind spots and backing maneuvers
decks.domain: Sharing roads with pedestrians, cyclists, motorcycles and large vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Trucks have large blind spots on both sides, so staying there can leave your vehicle ____.
cards.back: Trucks have large blind spots on both sides, so staying there can leave your vehicle unseen during a sudden lane change.
cards.memory_hook: unseen during a sudden lane change

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A truck may swing left to turn right; do not cut between it ____.
cards.back: A truck may swing left to turn right; do not cut between it and the curb or right shoulder.
cards.memory_hook: and the curb or right shoulder

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Do not cross behind a truck preparing to back into a loading area; wait rather ____.
cards.back: Do not cross behind a truck preparing to back into a loading area; wait rather than enter the driver’s blind spot.
cards.memory_hook: than enter the driver’s blind spot
